extracted.name: Everything Bagel Chicken Tenders
extracted.description: If you’re looking for new ways to use that Everything Bagel Seasoning then look no further. You have to try these Everything Bagel Chicken tenders. These tenders are so simple to make and simply delicious! (Air Fryer and Oven instructions included.)
ingredient_lines: 1 cup any kind of milk you have on hand (I used Almond milk)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl let the chicken tenders marinate in the buttermilk for 30 minutes to 1 hour. See my recipe tips on how to make your own buttermilk
Preheat oven to 350 degrees or air-fry (air fryer instructions included)
In a shallow dish, combine the panko bread crumbs, flour, and Everything Bagel Seasoning
Dip each chicken tender into the flour and panko bread mixture. Place each tender on a lightly greased baking sheet, then bake for 30 minutes, until cooked through

Air Fryer Instructions: Set Air fryer temperature to 350 degrees and spray the tenders with cooking spray after placing them into the air fryer basket. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes and flip the tenders halfway. Air fryer temps will vary. Bake in oven for 30 minutes. When your tenders reach 165 degrees inside and no longer pink they're done.
